## How to obtain a copy

Get the guide from the instrument owner, or from Revvity (formerly PerkinElmer) support / documentation channels for your instrument. Do not rely on third-party download mirrors.

## Local placement

After you have a legitimate copy, place files here (gitignored):

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `PerkinElmer-LS55-Users-Guide.pdf` | Official PDF |
| `LS55-Users-Guide.txt` | Optional searchable plain-text extract |

Project docs cite printed page numbers (`pp. N`) and optional text-extract line numbers (`txt ~N`) against those local files.
